summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of TGX BOT MVP. 30/30 pytest tests pass across auth, market, bind, bots, trade, wallet, transactions, revenue, referral, rewards, news, guide. Frontend flows verified: admin login -> dashboard ($10k wallet), pair page (BTCUSDT) manual BUY updated position + wallet + toast, Update Strategy, START BOT toggle, Bind API mode selectors, Wallet page with Deposit/Withdraw/Transfer + open position row, Transactions with filter chips, Revenue, Referral (code/copy/share/team), Rewards claim UI, News (4 items), Guide (5 steps), Profile w/ Logout -> /login, Register creates $1,000 wallet + welcome toast + redirects to /.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid; browsers will reject cookie flows if hit cross-origin. Works today only because frontend and API share the same domain via ingress.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown'); should migrate to FastAPI lifespan.

issues: Header shows 'Admin' with no rank/avatar chip parity with Profile; minor visual consistency

action_items: (FIXED by testing agent) POST /api/auth/register was returning 500 because motor added ObjectId `_id` to the doc dict in-place and it was returned in the response. Fixed by excluding `_id` from the returned user dict.
Optional: expose data-testid `mode-cycle` and `mode-oneshot` on TradingPair strategy trade-method buttons (spec mentions them, currently only `act-oneshot` is exposed for the action button).
Optional: tighten CORS by setting explicit origin(s) instead of '*' when using credentials.
Optional: migrate FastAPI startup handlers to lifespan context manager.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~730 lines; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, market, bots, trade, wallet, referral, rewards, content) for maintainability.
Response returned dict from `insert_one` mutated with _id — always project or drop `_id` before returning.

In /trade/order SELL branch, `margin_call_count` reset uses `bot.get('margin_call_count',0)` but earlier BUY branch increments it whenever prior position_amount > 0 which double-counts on first buy. Recommend explicit initialization when position was empty.
wallet_summary fetches live price per position sequentially inside a loop; parallelize with asyncio.gather for perf if many symbols.
referral commission on team-member trades is documented as deferred but no rewards row is generated for team SELLs; ensure UI copy in Referral does not promise 10% until implemented.
MASTER_KEY, JWT_SECRET committed to backend/.env — acceptable for preview but rotate for prod.
test_credentials: Admin admin@tgxbot.com / Admin@12345 (seeded). New users can register directly; get $1000 demo wallet + claimable welcome reward.
seed_data_creation: Session creates a fresh user per pytest session via /auth/register. Admin balance may drift between runs since tests place demo trades and deposits; assertions relaxed accordingly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend register 500 bug was fixed here — verify still healthy. All key data-testid IDs exist: pair-<SYMBOL>, act-buy/act-sell/act-close/act-oneshot, input-buyamt, save-config, suggest-btn, start-bot, mode-demo, mode-real. Pair page takes ~3-4s to load (fetches ticker/stats/bot). Toaster overlay can briefly cover clicks — prefer using data-testid selectors with force=True. Frontend URL is https://tgx-api-gateway.preview.emergentagent.com; backend prefix /api.
rca of the issue: Register 500 root cause: `await db.users.insert_one(doc)` mutates `doc` in-place adding `_id` (bson ObjectId). The endpoint then returned `doc` items filtering only `password_hash`, leaving `_id`. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId -> ValueError. Fix: also exclude `_id` when building the user response. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with any new email. Mitigation applied in server.py.
